QUESTION:
Which setting determines how much memory the logic that distributes messages across shards reserves for buffering?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0826] config | partitioner.buffer_bytes | version 4.x
# `partitioner.buffer_bytes`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (bytes) |
| Default | `16777216` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | bytes |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `partitioner.buffer_bytes` only if you observe problems with the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
buffer_bytes = 16777216
```

---

[d0899] config | partitioner.buffer_bytes (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `partitioner.buffer_bytes` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (bytes) |
| Default | `1048576` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | bytes |

## Notes

Changes to `partitioner.buffer_bytes` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
buffer_bytes = 1048576
```

---

[d0551] config | acktracker.buffer_bytes | version 4.x
# `acktracker.buffer_bytes`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, in bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (bytes) |
| Default | `134217728` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | bytes |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.buffer_bytes` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
buffer_bytes = 134217728
```

---
